drivingQuestion: What is the reason that affordability follows the one who vows?
outcomeNote: The reason is supplied from the verse and nothing presses against it in this unit.

segments.he: הֶשֵּׂג יָד בַּנּוֹדֵר, כֵּיצַד? עָנִי שֶׁהֶעֱרִיךְ אֶת הֶעָשִׁיר נוֹתֵן עֵרֶךְ עָנִי. מַאי טַעְמָא? דְּאָמַר קְרָא: ״אֲשֶׁר תַּשִּׂיג יַד הַנֹּדֵר״ — בְּנוֹדֵר תְּלָה רַחֲמָנָא.
segments.en: The mishna further teaches: «Affordability» is «in accordance with» the «one taking the vow; how» so? «A destitute person who valuated a wealthy person gives» the «valuation» in accordance with the means of the «destitute person.» The Gemara asks: «What is the reason? As the verse states: “According to the means of him who vowed,”» which teaches that «the Merciful One renders» the matter «dependent on the one who vows,» not upon the subject of the vow.
